benefit_text.en: ₹6,000 per year, paid directly to the farmer's bank account in 3 installments of ₹2,000 each.

eligibility_summary.en: Available to landholding farmer families across India, including Maharashtra.

status_notes.en: Central scheme; applies uniformly in Maharashtra.

benefit_text.en: Crop insurance covering yield loss. Farmer premium is capped at 2% for Kharif food & oilseed crops, 1.5% for Rabi food & oilseed crops, and 5% for annual commercial/horticultural crops. The government subsidizes the remaining premium.

eligibility_summary.en: Available for notified crops in notified areas; farmer must have insurable interest in the crop (owner or tenant cultivator).

status_notes.en: Central scheme; premium subsidized by government.

benefit_text.en: Short-term crop loans at a subsidized interest rate through a dedicated credit card linked to the farmer's landholding.

eligibility_summary.en: Available to landholding farmers and tenant farmers/sharecroppers.

official_link: Apply via any nationalized or cooperative bank

benefit_text.en: ₹6,000 per year state top-up, paid in addition to the central PM-KISAN benefit.

eligibility_summary.en: Same beneficiary base as PM-KISAN; auto-linked for eligible farmers.

en: Same as PM-KISAN (auto-linked, no separate application needed)

benefit_text.en: 80% subsidy for marginal farmers (under 1 hectare), 70% for small farmers (1-2 hectares), with an additional 10% top-up for farmers in Marathwada or Vidarbha.

eligibility_summary.en: Landholding up to 5 hectares; higher subsidy for marginal and small farmers; extra support in drought-prone regions.

status_notes.en: Budget-dependent; approved on a first-come-first-served basis since 2025-26. Application windows open and close through the year.

benefit_text.en: Subsidy on tractors up to 35HP (capped at ₹1,00,000) and on power tillers, rotavators, and seed drills.

eligibility_summary.en: Landholding-based eligibility; subsidy percentage varies by farmer category (verify exact % against current portal notification).

status_notes.en: Equipment must be purchased through an empanelled dealer.

scheme_name.en: Magel Tyala Saur Krishi Pump Yojana (Solar Pump)

benefit_text.en: Farmer pays only 10% of the solar pump cost (5% for SC/ST farmers); the rest is subsidized.

eligibility_summary.en: Landholding farmers; existing electricity connection status is considered during application.

benefit_text.en: Subsidy toward construction of an on-farm water storage pond.

eligibility_summary.en: Landholding must meet soil and water-availability suitability criteria.

benefit_text.en: Up to ₹4,00,000 for a new well and up to ₹1,00,000 for repair of an existing well.

eligibility_summary.en: Landholding between 0.4 and 6 hectares; land must be in the farmer's own name and free of encumbrance (“Boja”).

status_notes.en: Land must be free of any registered encumbrance.

scheme_name.en: Punyashlok Ahilyadevi Holkar Karjmafi Yojana (Loan Waiver)

benefit_text.en: Waiver of outstanding crop loan, amount as per the applicable government notification.

eligibility_summary.en: Farmers with an outstanding crop loan meeting the notification's criteria.

status_notes.en: Subject to periodic government notification; terms can change each cycle.

scheme_name.en: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY - Organic Farming Grant)

benefit_text.en: Support for vermicompost units, Jeevamrut infrastructure, and organic certification costs.

eligibility_summary.en: Farmer must join a cluster of at least 50 farmers and commit to organic practices for 3 years.
